title: Electronics III
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a device made up of several registers."
A memory is a device made up of several registers.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a device which converts a physical variable into an electrical signal."
A transducer is a device which converts a physical variable into an electrical signal.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a device that controls the physical quantity, temperature, in a computer-controlled system."
Actuator used in this illustration is a device that controls the physical quantity, temperature, in a computer-controlled system.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most commonly used word size."
A byte is the most commonly used word size.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as the ratio of the pulse width to the pulse period, expressed in percent."
Duty cycle is defined as the ratio of the pulse width to the pulse period, expressed in percent.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the inversion of its input."
The output of a NOT gate is the inversion of its input.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means the two sets of possible outputs remains in its last state indefinitely because of the internal latching action."
S and R both high means the two sets of possible outputs remains in its last state indefinitely because of the internal latching action.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a digital circuit which has logical relationship between input and output voltages."
A logic gate is a digital circuit which has logical relationship between input and output voltages.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an instrument used to measure the power or rate of consumption of electricity in a circuit in watts."
The wattmeter is an instrument used to measure the power or rate of consumption of electricity in a circuit in watts.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a broad class of semiconductor memories which are designed for those kinds of applications where only read operation is required."
The Read-Only Memory (ROM) is a broad class of semiconductor memories which are designed for those kinds of applications where only read operation is required.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a rugged and accurate instrument, but suffers from certain disadvantages."
The volt-ohm-milliameter (VOM) is a rugged and accurate instrument, but suffers from certain disadvantages.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to write the final digital circuit.  Exclusive-OR and exclusive-NOR gates are obtained by the combinations of three basic gates."
The MSP expression is used to write the final digital circuit.  Exclusive-OR and exclusive-NOR gates are obtained by the combinations of three basic gates.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the smallest change that can take place in the analogue output as a result of a change in the digital input."
Resolution (Step Size) The resolution is the smallest change that can take place in the analogue output as a result of a change in the digital input.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an equivalent of binary odometer."
A counter is an equivalent of binary odometer.
